title: geometryDefinition
description: The geometry definitions used in I3S version 1.7.

topology.description: Defines the topology type of the mesh. Must be: `triangle`

geometryBuffers.description: Array of geometry representation(s) for this class of meshes. When multiple representations are listed, Clients should select the most compact they support (e.g. Draco compressed mesh). For compatibility reasons, _uncompressed_ geometry buffer is always required and must be first (i.e. `geometryBuffers[0]`), so array length must be 1 or 2
